## Readings

1.  [GitHub Issues](https://learn-the-web.algonquindesign.ca/topics/github-issues/): a quick tutorial
2.  [Example of a long issue thread](https://github.com/STAT545-UBC/Discussion/issues/387) (just scan this to see how issues on GitHub can be used)
3.  Optional: [reprex R Package](https://github.com/tidyverse/reprex#what-is-a-reprex) (this could be helpful when trying to illustrate a bug or problem)

## Background

GitHub is much more than simply storage in the cloud. It can be used to collaborate and communicate. Making feature requests or pointing out bugs in software is a common use of the GitHub Issues feature.

## Task

<!-- Do this part during class since there is no other good way to verify that it is done! -->

First, find two other student's compiled files in their repository for a previous week's Case Study or task and provide feedback using the issues feature in GitHub. If they already have two *student written* issues find a different student to critique. You should mention things they could do to improve their visualization (or code).

### Submit

In I-learn, submit 2 URL's: one URL link to each of the issues you wrote in someone else's GitHub repository.
